_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 27, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And make the altar of offerings from acacia wood — five cubits its length, and five cubits its width, and let it be square, and three cubits its height.
translations.2: And make its horns upon its four sides; from it shall be its horns; and overlay it with copper.
translations.3: And make its pots for its ash, and its shovels and its basins and its forks and its fire-pans — all its vessels make from copper.
translations.4: And make for it a grating, after the fashion of a net, of copper; and make upon the net four rings of copper, at its four corners.
translations.5: And set it beneath the ledge of the altar from below, so that it reaches to its midpoint.
translations.6: And make poles for the altar from acacia wood, and overlay them with copper.
translations.7: And insert the poles into the rings, and they shall be upon the two sides of the altar when it is carried.
translations.8: And make it hollow planks — as you were shown upon the mountain, so shall they make it.
translations.9: And make the enclosure of the tabernacle: from the direction of the south wind, hanging drapes for the enclosure of fine twisted linen — a hundred cubits in length on the one side.
translations.10: And its pillars twenty, and their bases twenty of copper; and the clasps of the pillars and their coating, silver.
translations.11: And likewise on the north side in length — hanging drapes a hundred cubits in length, and their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty of copper; and the clasps of the pillars and their coating, silver.
translations.12: And the width of the enclosure on the west side — hanging drapes fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their bases ten.
translations.13: And the width of the enclosure on the east side — fifty cubits.
translations.14: Of these, fifteen cubits of hanging drapes for the one wing; their pillars three, and their bases three.
translations.15: And for the second wing, hanging drapes fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their bases three.
translations.16: And for the gate of the enclosure, a screen twenty cubits in length, of blue and purple and scarlet dye, and fine twisted linen — the work of an embroiderer; and it shall have four pillars and four bases.
translations.17: All the pillars of the enclosure round about are coated with silver, their clasps of silver, and their bases of copper.
translations.18: The length of the enclosure one hundred cubits, and its width fifty by fifty, and its height five cubits, of fine twisted linen, and their bases of copper.
translations.19: And the rest of the vessels of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the enclosure — of copper.
translations.20: And you — command the sons of Israel that they bring you pure olive oil, beaten, for illumination, to kindle therein the lamp continually.
translations.21: In the tent of the assembly, outside the curtain that is by the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it — from evening until morning before God — a perpetual ordinance unto all ages for their generations, from the sons of Israel.
